verdict.rationale: The evidence shows DigitalOcean (Paperspace's parent platform) offers remote and local MCP servers for managing DigitalOcean resources. Nothing in the pack says those servers expose Paperspace machines, notebooks, deployments or other Paperspace resources. Their listed tools cover DigitalOcean AI Platform resources, so this is a host-platform capability, not a Paperspace-specific official MCP server, and it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: DigitalOcean provides remote MCP servers that expose tools and context for managing your DigitalOcean resources.
